characterization_methods.key_findings: Increasing silicon accelerated κ-carbide formation and appeared to increase its volume fraction.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Aged 60 h at 530°C (Bartlett et al. Si-effect study)
characterization_methods.purpose: Study κ-carbide precipitation and the effect of silicon

characterization_methods.key_findings: No spinodal decomposition or SRO in solution-treated specimens regardless of Si; silicon partitions to austenite during aging and decreases the austenite lattice parameter.
characterization_methods.purpose: Confirm absence/presence of spinodal decomposition and short-range ordering; monitor lattice parameters

characterization_methods.key_findings: Silicon increased the carbon partitioning coefficient in κ-carbide from 2.1 (0.59% Si) to 2.9 (1.56% Si).
characterization_methods.purpose: Measure carbon partitioning and composition of κ-carbide

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Hardness Brinell (3000 kg), converted from Rockwell B and C scale measurements
characterization_methods.key_findings: 1.56% Si hardens to a plateau near 350 BHN (Fig. 2a); specific values 309 ± 5 (20 h), 318 ± 14 (10 h), 360 ± 6 (60 h), 375 ± 6 (40 h).
characterization_methods.purpose: Measure age-hardening response of the 1.56% Si steel at 530°C

characterization_methods.key_findings: Aged 20 h: YS 800 ± 21 MPa, UTS 834 ± 20 MPa, elongation 30.2 ± 9.6%; aged 60 h: YS 937 ± 8.9 MPa, UTS 1016 ± 2.5 MPa, elongation 13.2 ± 4.2%.
characterization_methods.purpose: Measure yield strength, ultimate tensile strength and elongation

characterization_methods.key_findings: Room temperature: 68 J (12 h aged), 35 J (30 h aged); -40°C: ~20 J (12 h), ~12 J (30 h) (Fig. 11).

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Fatigue-precracked Charpy specimens; aged 10 h and 40 h at 530°C
characterization_methods.technique: Instrumented Charpy impact testing (dynamic fracture toughness via Schindler single-specimen method)

characterization_methods.key_findings: 12 h aged broken at -40°C: transgranular cleavage-like fracture with slip traces on favorably oriented facets; at ~350 BHN: brittle transgranular cleavage facets with {111} slip traces.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: 12 h aged specimen broken at -40°C; specimens aged to ~300 and ~350 BHN

analytical_models.equation_role: Predict yield strength increase with Si content for specimens aged 60 h at 530°C
analytical_models.model_name: Spinodal hardening mechanism (derived from Kato et al.)
analytical_models.model_note: Silicon increases the activity of carbon in austenite and stabilizes κ-carbide at higher temperatures; repulsive Si-C interaction increases carbon partitioning into κ-carbide.

computational_details.validation_against_experiment: Predicted yield-strength increase in reasonable agreement with previously reported mechanical properties

interfaces.interface_notes: κ-carbide has a cube-on-cube orientation relationship with austenite: <100>κ // <100>γ and {001}κ // {001}γ.
interfaces.phase_evolution: During 530°C aging, coherent nano-sized κ-carbide precipitates homogeneously; silicon increases κ-carbide formation kinetics, carbon content and volume fraction, while silicon partitions to austenite.
interfaces.slip_behavior: Planar slip; κ-carbide precipitation contributes to planar slip, and shearing of κ-carbides concentrates slip on relatively few slip bands.

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: Room-temperature CVN breaking energy and dynamic fracture toughness in the aged condition (~310 BHN)
comparative_performance.improvement_percentage: CVN decreased from 92 J to 68 J; dynamic fracture toughness decreased from 376 kJ/m² to 265 kJ/m²

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: Room-temperature CVN breaking energy for 12 h and 30 h aged low-P (<0.003% P) steels
comparative_performance.improvement_percentage: 12 h: decreased from 93 J to 68 J; 30 h: decreased from 58 J to 35 J

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: Tensile properties of low-P (<0.007% P) steels aged 60 h at 530°C
comparative_performance.improvement_percentage: YS 873 → 937 MPa; UTS 953 → 1016 MPa; elongation decreased from 20% to 13%

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Parent solution treatment for the cast 1.56% Si, low-P steel before 530°C aging.

Age hardening at 530°C precipitates homogeneous coherent nano-sized κ-carbide. Reported aging times for this 1.56% Si sample: 10 h (DFT), 12 h (CVN), 20 h (tensile), 30 h (CVN), 40 h (DFT), 60 h (tensile).
